driver checks only runs/*/result.json accepted; it does not inspect prior launches
outer launch can remain without result after a pre-Popen failure, or fail/be incomplete after an accepted inner driver result

Current launch is legitimately already created before driver starts: exclude only the current grant-bound in-progress invocation, not all missing launch results and not an arbitrary same-name historical failure.
